title: Boy and Robotic Dog
description: A young boy with glowing blue hair and swirling energy rings around his head stands pointing to his temple, smiling beside a mechanical dog with rocket boosters on its feet. The surreal night scene features a swirling colorful sky, floating gears, circuit boards, a streetlamp, and a Retroville Malt Shop sign.
prompt: A whimsical surreal digital painting of a smiling young boy with brown hair, blue eyes, and a striped red shirt with a bowtie, standing and pointing to his temple as bright blue energy swirls and crackles from his head with orbiting rings. Beside him is a happy robotic dog with metallic body, exposed gears, rocket flames from its feet, and tongue out. The background shows a swirling colorful vortex sky in purple, teal and orange, floating circuit boards, gears, a glowing streetlamp, a Retroville Malt Shop sign, and dripping purple liquid, in a vibrant cartoon style.
